content.short: Token launchpad on Stable where every token trades against USDT0 and creators earn rewards.
content.description: COINS.FUN is the main place to launch memecoins and community tokens on Stable. Each new token gets its own USDT0 market straight away, and creators collect rewards from trading on their token, with more than $40,000 in USDT0 claimed so far. Over 100 tokens have launched, trading a combined total of about $7.9 million.
content.meta: Create a token on Stable with COINS.FUN and trade it instantly against USDT0, with rewards for token creators.
